{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

duplicates = df['patient_id'].duplicated(keep=False)

duplicate_patient_ids = df[duplicates]['patient_id'].unique()

df_duplicates = df[duplicates]

df_duplicates_sorted = df_duplicates.sort_values(by=['patient_id', 'sample_seq'], ascending=[True, False])

# Keep only the highest sample_seq for each patient_id
df_deduplicated = df_duplicates_sorted.drop_duplicates(subset=['patient_id'], keep='first')

# Now combine with non-duplicated patients
non_duplicates = df[~duplicates]

# Final dataset with one row per patient
df_final = pd.concat([non_duplicates, df_deduplicated], ignore_index=True)

# Total number of unique patients
n_patients = df_final['patient_id'].nunique()

print(f'Number of unique patients: {n_patients}')"}
